name: cocoapods
description: CocoaPods.org is the public registry of Swift/Objective-C libraries (pods). This CLI searches pods by keyword through the site's Algolia index and reads pod detail pages, pod changelogs and owner profiles.

commands.name: search-pods
commands.summary: Search CocoaPods libraries by keyword. Returns name, version, summary, license, platforms, download counts and repo owner. Paginated, 20 per page.

params.name: query
params.description: Search keywords matched against pod name, summary, authors and repo owner. Prefix matching works, e.g. 'alamo' finds Alamofire.

params.name: page
params.description: Zero-based result page. The response field nbPages gives the total number of pages.

commands.name: get-pod
commands.summary: Get one pod's detail page: version, metadata table (tests, language, license, release, SPM), first maintainer, Podfile line, podspec/GitHub links and README text.

params.name: name
params.description: Exact pod name, case-sensitive as published, e.g. Alamofire (use the 'name' field from search-pods).

commands.name: get-pod-changelog
commands.summary: Get a pod's CHANGELOG as rendered text. Some pods only contain a link to their GitHub releases (see first_link).

params.name: name
params.description: Exact pod name, case-sensitive as published, e.g. Alamofire (use the 'name' field from search-pods).

commands.name: list-owner-pods
commands.summary: List all pods maintained by an owner (numeric owner id from get-pod's maintainer_url), with summary, license and language.

params.name: id
params.description: Numeric owner id, e.g. 2662 taken from /owners/2662.

notes: search-pods calls the site's public Algolia index using the read-only search key the web app embeds. Pages are zero-based; nbHits and nbPages in the raw response give the totals.
In search-pods, query is placed inside an Algolia 'params' string. Avoid '&' and '=' in queries; plain words and spaces work.
Pod names are case-sensitive in /pods/{name}. Use the exact 'name' value from search-pods.

get-pod's 'metadata' field is the sidebar table flattened to text (Tests, Language, License, Released, SPM support). 'maintainer' and 'maintainer_url' cover only the first maintainer; 'maintained_by' lists them all as text.
Owner ids appear only in maintainer links (/owners/{id}) on pod pages. Pass the number to list-owner-pods.
podspec_url links to the sharded podspec in the CocoaPods/Specs GitHub repo. Fetch it from GitHub if you need the raw spec.
The site shows a notice that CocoaPods trunk is moving to read-only, so new releases may be rare.
